cli.analyze.error_line: error: %s: %s. Michel kept the other analyses; fix the cause, then run 'michel analyze --project %s --force'.
cli.analyze.need_target: Michel needs to know what to analyze. Pass --project <name> for one project, or --all for every active project. 'michel project list' shows the names.
cli.analyze.no_active: There is no active project to analyze. Register one with 'michel project add <path> --name <name>'.
cli.analyze.none: Michel could not analyze any project. Read the errors above, fix them, then run the analysis again.
cli.analyze.not_clean: the analysis did not complete cleanly
cli.analyze.not_found: Cannot analyze %s: no project has this name. Run 'michel project list' to see the registered names.
cli.analyze.removed: Cannot analyze %s: the project was removed, so Michel no longer analyzes it (its history is kept). Register the folder again with 'michel project add'.
cli.audit.list.bad_last: --last must be at least 1. Pass a positive number of events to show
cli.audit.verify.broken_tail: audit: BROKEN at tail: tail truncated (expected %d events, found %d)
cli.audit.verify.head_absent: audit: head anchor absent (%s is missing), so the removal of the newest events cannot be checked. The next recorded event writes it again.
cli.common.audit_also: %s Also, Michel could not write the audit log: %v
cli.db.rule_missing: db update requires network.allow entry {host: %s, purpose: %s}. Michel never downloads anything that is not listed in your policy. Add this entry under sovereignty.network.allow in config.yaml, then run 'michel db update' again.
cli.db.update.audit_failed: The databases were updated but Michel could not write the audit log: %v. Check that the data folder is writable
cli.db.update.failed: Database update failed for %s: %v. The previous database for the failed ecosystem, if any, was kept. Check your network and the policy, then run 'michel db update' again.
cli.db.update.failed_kept: Database update failed for %s: %v. Already installed and kept: %s. The previous database for the failed ecosystem, if any, was kept. Check your network and the policy, then run 'michel db update' again.
cli.decide.audit_failed: The decision on %s (%s) was saved, but Michel could not write the audit log: %v. Check that the data folder is writable.
cli.decide.bad_for: Michel cannot read the duration %q. Write a number of days followed by d, for example 30d.
cli.decide.bad_until: Michel cannot read the date %q. Write it as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-12-01.
cli.decide.due_in_past: The deferral date %s is not in the future. Pick a later date with --until, or a number of days with --for.
cli.decide.failed: Cannot save the decision on %s (%s): %v. Nothing was changed; check that the data folder is writable and try again.
cli.decide.gone: Cannot decide on %s (%s) in %s: it is no longer seen at the last scan. If it comes back, Michel will ask you again only if something changed.
cli.decide.package_needs_project: --package needs --project: a package name only means something inside a project. Add --project <name>.
cli.decide.package_none: No finding of %s in %s waits for a decision. Run 'michel findings --project %s' to see them, or add --force to decide again on findings already decided.
cli.decide.project_not_found: Cannot decide in %s: no project has this name. Run 'michel project list' to see the registered names.
cli.decide.unknown_action: Unknown action %q. Use fix, defer or ignore.
cli.decide.usage: Michel needs a finding and an action. Run 'michel decide <id> fix|defer|ignore', or 'michel decide --project <name> --package <package> fix|defer|ignore' for every finding of a package.
cli.decide.why_required: Ignoring a finding needs a reason. Add --why "..." to say why it does not matter to you; Michel keeps it in the audit log.
cli.decide.why_too_long: The reason is too long (%d characters, at most %d). Shorten --why.
cli.decisions.need_project: Michel needs a project. Pass --project <name>; 'michel project list' shows the names.
cli.decisions.none: No decisions to show for %s. Decide on a finding with 'michel decide <id> fix|defer|ignore'; 'michel findings --project %s' shows the ids.
cli.decisions.not_found: Cannot list decisions for %s: no project has this name. Run 'michel project list' to see the registered names.
cli.digest.bad_since: Michel cannot read the date %q. Write it as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-10-20.
cli.finding.ambiguous: The id prefix %q matches %d findings. Type more characters of the id. Candidates:
cli.finding.ambiguous_capped: The id prefix %q matches at least %d findings. Type more characters of the id. Candidates:
cli.finding.not_found: No finding has the id %q. Run 'michel findings --project <name>' to see the ids.
cli.findings.need_project: Michel needs a project. Pass --project <name>; 'michel project list' shows the names.
cli.findings.none: No findings to show for %s. Run 'michel scan --project %s' to refresh them.
cli.findings.not_found: Cannot list findings for %s: no project has this name. Run 'michel project list' to see the registered names.
cli.project.add.audit_failed: Project %s was added but Michel could not write the audit log: %v. Check that the data folder is writable
cli.project.add.bad_classification: Cannot add project: unknown classification. Use one of public, internal, confidential, sensitive, health.
cli.project.add.bad_exclude: Cannot add project: %v. --exclude skips every folder with that name, at any depth.
cli.project.add.bad_fix_level: Cannot add project: the fix level must be 0, 1, 2 or 3. Pass --fix-level with one of these values (default 1).
cli.project.add.duplicate: Cannot add project: a project named %q already exists. Names must be unique. Choose another --name, or run 'michel project remove %s --purge' first (a removed project keeps its name until it is purged).
cli.project.add.empty_name: Cannot add project: the name is empty. Give it a short name with --name, for example --name my-shop.
cli.project.add.invalid: Cannot add project: %v. Check the arguments and try again.
cli.project.add.not_dir: Cannot add project: %s is not a directory. Michel scans a project folder on this machine. Give the folder that contains the code (for example the one with composer.lock or package-lock.json).
cli.project.add.save_failed: Cannot add project: %v. Michel could not save it; check that the data folder is writable and try again.
cli.project.remove.already_inactive: Project %s was already inactive; its history is kept. Run 'michel project remove %s --purge' to delete it for good.
cli.project.remove.audit_failed: Project %s was removed (%s) but Michel could not write the audit log: %v. Check that the data folder is writable
cli.project.remove.done: Removed project %s: Michel no longer scans it, and its scans and findings are kept as history. Run 'michel project remove %s --purge' to delete that history too.
cli.project.remove.failed: Cannot remove project %s: %v. Nothing was changed; check that the data folder is writable and try again.
cli.project.remove.not_found: Cannot remove project %s: no project has this name. Run 'michel project list' to see the registered names.
cli.project.remove.purged: Purged project %s: its scans and findings were deleted and cannot be recovered. The audit log keeps the record of what happened. The folder %s was not touched.
cli.project.set.audit_failed: Project %s was updated but Michel could not write the audit log: %v. Check that the data folder is writable
cli.project.set.bad_risk: Cannot update project %s: --risk %q must look like key=number, for example major_jump=10.
cli.project.set.bad_thresholds: Cannot update project %s: these overrides give auto_fix_below=%d and handoff_up_to=%d. auto_fix_below must stay below handoff_up_to, which must be at most 100; terms must be 0 to 100. Nothing was changed.
cli.project.set.failed: Cannot update project %s: %v. Nothing was changed.
cli.project.set.not_found: Cannot update project %s: no project has this name. Run 'michel project list' to see the registered names.
cli.project.set.nothing: Cannot update project: nothing to change. Pass at least one of --core-package, --exclude, --risk, --fix-level, --classification, --test-cmd, --install-cmd.
cli.project.set.recompute: Analysis will be recomputed on the next scan or `michel analyze --project %s`.
cli.project.set.save_failed: Cannot update project %s: %v. Nothing was changed; check that the data folder is writable and try again.
cli.root.audit_write: Michel cannot write its audit log: %[2]v. Check that %[1]s is writable
cli.root.no_config_dir: Michel cannot find your user configuration folder (%v). Pass --config and --data-dir to say where to read and store its files
cli.root.policy_invalid: Policy file %s is invalid: %v. Michel refuses to start with an inconsistent policy. Fix the file or delete it to use the built-in strict_local defaults.
cli.root.policy_unreadable: %v. Michel refuses to start without a readable policy. Fix the file or delete it to use the built-in strict_local defaults.
cli.root.unknown_lang: Unknown language %q. Use --lang en or --lang fr.
cli.scan.digest_needs_all: --digest only works with --all, because the digest covers every active project. Run 'michel scan --all --digest'.
cli.scan.need_target: Michel needs to know what to scan. Pass --project <name> for one project, or --all for every active project. 'michel project list' shows the names.
cli.scan.no_active: There is no active project to scan. Register one with 'michel project add <path> --name <name>'.
cli.scan.no_manifests: Michel found no composer.lock or package-lock.json under %s, so it scanned nothing and kept the earlier findings of %s. Michel only scans lockfiles; the folder may be empty or unmounted, or the lockfiles may sit under an excluded folder (node_modules, vendor, .git). Check the path with 'michel project list', or add the lockfile and scan again.
cli.scan.none_scanned: Michel could not scan any project. Read the errors above, fix them, then run the scan again.
cli.scan.not_clean: the scan did not complete cleanly
cli.scan.not_found: Cannot scan %s: no project has this name. Run 'michel project list' to see the registered names.
cli.scan.removed: Cannot scan %s: the project was removed, so Michel no longer scans it (its history is kept). Register the folder again under another name with 'michel project add', or purge it with 'michel project remove %s --purge' and add it back.
cli.scan.some_failed.one: Michel could not scan %d project; read the errors above, fix them, then run the scan again.
cli.scan.some_failed.other: Michel could not scan %d projects; read the errors above, fix them, then run the scan again.
cli.scan.summary.no_new: Michel found no new findings in %s
cli.scan.summary.reappeared.one: ; %d finding came back after being gone
cli.scan.summary.reappeared.other: ; %d findings came back after being gone
cli.scan.warn_analysis_error: warning: %s: analysis: %v. Fix the cause, then run 'michel analyze --project %s --force'.
cli.scan.warn_analysis_failed: warning: %s: the analysis failed: %v. The scan itself is saved; run 'michel analyze --project %s' to retry.
cli.scan.warn_ignored_config: Warning: %s contains osv-scanner ignore rules; Michel does not apply them. Decide on findings with michel decide (plan 3) instead.
cli.scan.warn_manifest_error: warning: %s: %v. Fix or remove the file, then scan again; its earlier findings were kept.
cli.secret.audit_failed: Michel changed the secret %s, but could not write the audit log: %v. Check that the data folder is writable.
cli.secret.delete_failed: Michel cannot delete the secret %s: %v. Check that the data folder is writable, then try again.
cli.secret.empty: The value of %s is empty, so Michel stored nothing. Pipe the value into the command, or type it when Michel asks.
cli.secret.invalid_name: This secret name is not valid. Use 1 to 64 characters among lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, for example smtp-password.
cli.secret.list_empty: No secret stored yet. Add one with 'michel secret set <name>'.
cli.secret.list_failed: Michel cannot read the secrets folder: %v. Check that the data folder is readable.
cli.secret.not_found: There is no secret named %s. Run 'michel secret list' to see the names.
cli.secret.open_failed: Michel cannot open the secrets folder in %s: %v. Check that this folder is writable.
cli.secret.plain_warning: Note: on %s, Michel stores secrets in plain text, protected only by the file permissions (only your user account can read them). Encryption by the system keychain comes in a later version.
cli.secret.read_failed: Michel cannot read the value: %v. Nothing was stored.
cli.secret.reserved: The name %s is reserved: michel serve creates and manages this token itself. Choose another name. To get a new token, run 'michel secret delete api-token', then start michel serve again.
cli.secret.set_failed: Michel cannot store the secret %s: %v. Nothing changed. Check that the data folder is writable, then try again.
cli.secret.too_long: The value of %s is longer than %d bytes, so Michel stored nothing. A secret is a password or a token, not a file.
digest.osv_stale: Warning: the vulnerability database is %d days old; run michel db update.
digest.word.calm: All quiet. Keep it that way.
explain.label.hint: Run "michel analyze --project %s" to complete this view.
explain.label.noversions: versions unreadable, breaking changes not assessed
explain.label.risk_jump_unknown_handoff: update size unknown, so handed over
explain.label.risk_thresholds_fallback: project thresholds inconsistent, policy thresholds used
explain.label.tests_many: %d test files cover the code that uses it
explain.label.tests_one: 1 test file covers the code that uses it
explain.severity.critical: could let an attacker take control
glossary.breaking: a change that can make code written for the old version stop working
glossary.cve: a public identifier for a known security flaw
glossary.cvss: a 0 to 10 score of how severe a flaw is
glossary.kev: a list of flaws that attackers are known to exploit in the wild
glossary.lockfile: the file that records the exact versions installed
glossary.transitive: a package your project does not ask for itself, but that another package needs
